display.purpose: Landing hero, closing statement, 404 and error headlines.

headline.purpose: Page headers and prominent section titles.

mono.purpose: Timestamps, hashes, seeds, model metadata and tabular numerals.

shadows.name: panel-ambient

shadows.name: dot-glow
shadows.purpose: Status dots; removed for the idle tone.

shadows.name: solid-hover-ring

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Outlined pill; the default action on marketing surfaces and the header.
components.html: Enter a round »
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-display, "Host Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1; padding: 0.72rem 1.4rem; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { color: var(--ink, #f3eff7); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #7c6bff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-arrow { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Filled monochrome pill for form submits and the one decisive action.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--ink, #f3eff7); color: #0a070d; font-family: var(--font-display, "Host Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1; padding: 0.72rem 1.4rem; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 46 147 / 0.35); } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #7c6bff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-solid:disabled { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis hairline pill for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08)); background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #a79fb4); font-family: var(--font-display, "Host Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1; padding: 0.72rem 1.4rem; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--ink, #f3eff7); border-color: var(--hairline-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14)); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #7c6bff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line input with a 3:1 control boundary and violet focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-email">Email</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-mono, "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--faint, #8a8297); } .ds-field { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02); padding: 0.68rem 0.85rem; font-family: var(--font-display, "Host Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink, #f3eff7); transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #8a8297); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--hairline-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14)); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--violet, #7c6bff); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.035); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--violet, #7c6bff); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The canonical translucent surface: gradient fill, hairline, inner highlight, one ambient drop.
components.html:
Live pool

Three models, one brief.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.042), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.012)); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08)); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06), 0 28px 70px -34px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(125%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(125%); padding: 24px; } .ds-panel-label { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--muted, #a79fb4); } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font-family: var(--font-display, "Host Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.68; color: var(--ink, #f3eff7); }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: A 6px dot plus an uppercase mono word — never a filled chip.
components.html: Staking open
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-mono, "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #a79fb4); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--dot, var(--faint, #8a8297)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px -1px var(--dot, var(--faint, #8a8297)); flex: none; } .ds-status-live { --dot: var(--magenta, #ff2e93); } .ds-dot-pulse::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -3px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--dot, var(--magenta, #ff2e93)); opacity: 0; animation: ds-dot-breathe 3.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-dot-breathe { 0% { transform: scale(0.7); opacity: 0.55; } 70% { transform: scale(1.9); opacity: 0; } 100% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot-pulse::after { animation: none; } }

components.name: Meter
components.description: 3px instrument track with a magenta-to-violet fill, always labelled.
components.css: .ds-meter { position: relative; height: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter > span { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--magenta-deep, #b30e63), var(--magenta, #ff2e93) 62%, var(--violet, #7c6bff)); }

components.name: Readout
components.description: Labelled tabular number — the atom of the cockpit and dashboard strip.
components.css: .ds-readout-label { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--faint, #8a8297); } .ds-readout-value { margin: 0.375rem 0 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--ink, #f3eff7); } .ds-readout-suffix { margin-left: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #a79fb4); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Uppercase tracked mono link; active state is ink text plus a magenta dot.
components.html: Leaderboard
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--muted, #a79fb4); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink, #f3eff7); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #7c6bff); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--ink, #f3eff7); } .ds-nav-dot { position: absolute; bottom: -6px; left: 50%; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--magenta, #ff2e93); transform: translateX(-50%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-dot { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: The whole application is a single instrument: near-black ground, hairline geometry, and a monochrome structure that carries every task without decoration. Meaning is not distributed across a rainbow; it is concentrated — one magenta for what is live, one violet for what is locked or verified, and nothing else competing. The page should read as a precision cockpit that happens to be alive, not as a decorated dashboard. The "alive" comes from material and field, never from UI chrome. A WebGL flow-field vortex is the only organic object; halftone dot screens, a fine film grain and a vignette sit at the edges of the frame like the room the interface occupies. Surfaces are translucent glass with a one-pixel hairline and an inner top highlight — material you could touch, not a glowing card. Display type is Host Grotesk set light and tight; Azeret Mono does every readout, label, hash and timer, so metadata looks measured rather than merchandised. The world explicitly refuses the category default of neon-on-black cyberpunk: no glowing headlines, no gradient-filled text, no rainbow accent spray. Glow exists physically in the vortex, the status dot and the thin meters. Every control stays quiet, legible and monochrome until a dot or a meter tells you what state you are in.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only; void ground with hairline-separated translucent glass.
Two accents only: magenta (#ff2e93) alive, violet (#7c6bff) locked/verifiable; amber (#e0a45e) reserved for account warning states.
Halftone, grain and vignette at the page edges; one WebGL vortex as the organic centerpiece.
Host Grotesk display and UI; Azeret Mono for readouts, hashes, timers and tracked micro-labels.
Status is a 6px dot plus a word; depth is glass and hairline, not drop-shadow stacking.
Motion is slow, easing-out, and resolves to a composed still under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Magenta and violet are the only chromatic voices on the page. If a new element needs a third hue, it is wrong; reuse a dot, a weight change or a hairline instead.

rules.name: The Amber Exception Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on account-state warnings (missing wallet, practice mode, missing profile). It never marks a round's state and never decorates.

rules.name: The Ground Rule
rules.body: There is no light theme. Backgrounds are void-to-void-lift gradients, and no surface may sit lighter than a 4.2%-white glass fill over them.

rules.name: The Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Metadata is set in uppercase Azeret Mono at 0.14em or more of tracking. It is a text block, not a badge, chip or colored pill.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Any number that a person compares — points, stakes, percentages, counts — uses tabular numerals. Prose never gets monospaced; numerals never get proportional.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-Material Rule
rules.body: Glass is a material, not decoration: use the full panel recipe for content surfaces, panel-quiet for informational strips and empty states, and never fake a glass look with blur alone.

rules.name: The One-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface gets the panel ambient or no shadow. No stacked shadows, no offset hard shadows, no glow around cards.

dos: Do keep magenta and violet as the only chromatic accents, and let amber appear only on account warnings.
Do express status as a 6px dot plus an uppercase mono word, with shape and word carrying the meaning.
Do build surfaces from the glass recipe: 1px hairline, inner top highlight, 4.2→1.2%-white gradient, 18px radius, one ambient drop.
Do set every number a person compares in tabular Azeret Mono, and every label in uppercase tracked mono at 0.14em or more.
Do keep the atmosphere at the frame edges and behind the hero; body copy never sits on an unmasked halftone field.
Do keep focus visible with the global 2px violet ring at 3px offset on every interactive element.
Do resolve all motion to a composed still under prefers-reduced-motion, including the vortex.
donts: Don't introduce a light theme, a third accent, gradient-filled text or glowing headlines.
Don't turn a status into a filled neon chip, badge or colored pill.
Don't stack shadows, offset hard shadows, or add hover lift to cards.
Don't replace glass with blur alone or add colored card glows; colored light belongs to fields and dots.
Don't use monospace for prose or proportional figures for readouts.
Don't let a decorative micro-label stand in for real state; metadata labels carry information, not ornament.
